notes: The gateway fails over on a usage-limit 429 by itself: aliax-core 6add708 classifies the refusal (unified headers and Claude/Codex bodies), marks the pinned account's window full with the provider's reset, asks AccountsService.pickNext for the next account with room in every window the refused and every live model spend (soonest reset first, confirmed by a forced poll), pins it and replays the buffered request under its token at most three times; onFailedOver signs the CLIs in behind the new pin and any failure shows as a footer note. One reset timer per build re-polls the accounts whose full windows just reset, only while Aliax is not the owner. scripts/e2e-gateway-failover.ts covers it end to end against a fake upstream
